answer: The portcullis is Chartered sugar crusher cane log with sugar crushers confirmation. It drops on 2-year training, 417 supervised crushings, theory exam, annual fees, and it drops separately for every key. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 113 POA and 18 minutes each, 76727 POA and 12222 minutes in all. The vault names the issuer, the plume names the price, and the harbor names the date: a forger must forge all three. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
